summary: Full end-to-end testing of Hybrid Quantum Image Classifier. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (health, root, predict, predict/frame, history list, get by id, 404 handling, clear history). Frontend: home hero, sidebar, all nav links (home/upload/camera/video/history), upload page dropzone/file-input/preview/predict-button flow, result-display with class + confidence + probability bars + inference time verified. Prediction of test image returned 'Road' 40.8% in ~1600ms end-to-end via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: ml_core/inference.py generate_gradcam() uses np.random for the heatmap instead of true GradCAM — acceptable for MVP but misleading; label as 'placeholder heatmap' or implement real GradCAM against ResNet50 last conv layer.
server.py catches all exceptions with generic 500 in /predict; consider distinguishing invalid image (400) from inference errors (500).
History endpoint response omits inference_time_ms and probabilities via PredictionHistory model — that's fine for listing but ensure frontend HistoryPage doesn't attempt to read those fields.
seed_data_creation: Test prediction created via /api/predict then cleared with DELETE /api/history
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and core frontend flows are working. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_hqic_api.py can be re-run for regression. Camera page loaded but webcam capture not exercised (headless). GradCAM is currently a random heatmap placeholder.
